## Contributor checks

- [ ] Data changes, source records and behavioral fixtures are included together.
- [ ] Each factual field is supported; unknown fields have not been guessed.
- [ ] Historical, market and year restrictions or ambiguity are represented explicitly.
- [ ] Redistribution rights were reviewed separately from the code license.
- [ ] Attached source material is permitted for redistribution; no customer VINs are included.
- [ ] Dataset version was incremented; Python tests, `libs/java` Maven verification and parity checks passed.

## Human review

Record why the source is authoritative, which fields it establishes, and why its terms permit
this contribution. Green CI checks consistency and regressions, not factual or legal correctness.
